stem: A student learning about U.S. history is instructed to write a paper about W. E. B. Du Bois and race relations in the United States. Which of the following facts would be most relevant to the student's assignment?

options.label: A
options.text: The Selma-to-Montgomery protest marches helped secure voting rights for minority citizens.

options.label: B
options.text: The NAACP was organized to help secure full legal equality for minority citizens.

options.label: C
options.text: The Civil Rights Act of 1968 outlawed many forms of discrimination in the housing market.

options.label: D
options.text: The March on Washington helped rally nationwide support for the Civil Rights movement.
